title: Implement Stateful Doors, Collection Triggers, and Restroom 004
objective: Add validated optional door/trigger level data, reusable animated blocking doors, one-shot collection-count runtime triggers, and a soft-lock-resistant three-area restroom_004 demonstration without changing prior gameplay or the accepted player.
acceptance: doors and triggers are optional but always normalized arrays, preserving restroom_001 through restroom_003
door and trigger validation rejects duplicate IDs, unknown door references, out-of-range thresholds, non-positive size/duration, and unsupported types/actions with field-specific errors
the reusable Door exposes stable Visual and StaticBody3D/CollisionShape3D children, CLOSED/OPENING/OPEN state, configure(), and idempotent open() returning true once
door root tweens by open_offset over positive open_duration so visible mesh and blocking collision travel together and open_count remains one
RestroomRuntime owns doors_by_id, trigger_fired, and trigger_fire_count and evaluates one-shot collect_count/open_door triggers only after successful collection
empty toilets and duplicate collections do not advance objective or triggers, while final exit unlock/completion behavior remains intact
restroom_004 contains 6–8 collectible and 2–3 empty toilets, two ordered non-bypassable gates, and three meaningful areas; Door A opens at 2 and Door B at 4 or 5
the level provides enough reachable collectibles before each closed gate, at least one beyond Door B, no required-collectible soft lock, and a usable final exit
TB-001 through TB-R04C regressions with TB-H01 stabilization pass; TB-R05 is reported not present rather than fabricated
door closed/open, middle-area, gameplay renders, Godot validation, Linux export, and exported runtime loading of restroom_001 through restroom_004 pass
player scene, player movement, collision behavior, prior levels, tests, pickup feedback, audio, and unrelated systems do not change
